# recipe-fit-assessor

Purpose: Score whether a user's 3D goal fits an existing BlendOps recipe or pack, or needs custom decomposition, and name the exact next skill.

Map a user's stated goal to the closest documented BlendOps recipe or pack before expensive planning or runtime work, returning a fit verdict (`Strong` / `Partial` / `Poor`), rationale, explicit gap list, and **one** recommended next skill. This skill is planning-only and never runs Blender, packs, or runtime.

Metadata: Contract `v1.0.0` | Category `routing-and-governance` | Role `recipe-and-pack-selector` | Tier `L0` | Runtime default `Not Run` | Artifact default `Not Produced` | Mutation `downgrade_only`
Routing precedence: group `entry-and-stage-routing`, rank `2` | activationGate: `goalClarity="clear"`, `recipeSelected=false`, `preflightPassed=false`, `hasStageOrArtifactInventory=false`

## When to use & trigger cues
- user asks "which recipe / pack fits my idea"
- scope drifts between product hero, portrait, interior, web GLB, batch renders
- before locking `intent-to-3d-brief-writer` output to a pack
- Trigger phrases: "what recipe should I use", "does product hero fit", "closest workflow for X", "which pack"

## When not to use (delegation boundaries)
- Diverging raw creative ideas before a delivery shape exists → use `blender-brainstorming` (`references/skill-blender-brainstorming.md`; Explores creative directions and clarifies vague ideas before recipe selection)
- General entry routing across BlendOps when the goal itself is unclear → use `blendops-help` (`references/skill-blendops-help.md`; Handles ambiguous entry triage at precedence Rank 1)
- Checking whether a selected pack's preflight prerequisites are met → use `pack-prerequisite-checker` (`references/skill-pack-prerequisite-checker.md`; Evaluates preflight readiness once the recipe/pack is already selected)
- Picking the next workflow stage after preflight passed and artifacts already exist → use `workflow-stage-router` (`references/skill-workflow-stage-router.md`; Routes active in-flight workflows at precedence Rank 4)
- Writing the structured 8-slot 3D brief after recipe fit is settled → use `intent-to-3d-brief-writer` (`references/skill-intent-to-3d-brief-writer.md`; Authors the formal brief after recipe fit is determined)
- Detailed scene planning once a domain and brief are locked → use `product-hero-scene-planner` (`references/skill-product-hero-scene-planner.md`; Builds the domain-specific scene plan after preflight passes)
- Runtime setup, path selection, or bridge conflict troubleshooting → use `runtime-path-picker` (`references/skill-runtime-path-picker.md`; Handles MCP runtime selection and setup outside recipe scoring)
- Legal or asset license verification → use `asset-license-checker` (`references/skill-asset-license-checker.md`; Audits asset provenance and license compatibility)

## Input & output contract
- Required input `user_goal_summary` (`string`): Plain-language 3D goal and intended deliverable subject
- Required input `target_output_destination` (`string`): Target format or channel (e.g., hero still, catalog grid, turntable, web GLB)
- Optional input `candidate_pack_hint` (`string`): Optional pack or recipe the user is considering
- Output contract: `recipe_fit_verdict`, `candidate_comparison_table`, `recommended_next_skill` (Runtime status: `Not Run`, Artifact status: `Not Produced`, `downgrade_only`).

## Quick-start steps
1. capture goal + constraints + deliverables
2. compare against catalog rows in `skills/recipe-fit-assessor/references/recipe-catalog.md`
3. assign fit verdict (Strong / Partial / Poor)
4. list gap fixes or recommend a different workflow entrypoint

## Cross-skill handoffs
- [upstream_reference] Upstream creative divergence → `blender-brainstorming` (`references/skill-blender-brainstorming.md`) — `when.all: [goal.clarity equals "ambiguous_or_mixed"]`
- [boundary_delegation] General entry routing → `blendops-help` (`references/skill-blendops-help.md`) — `when.all: [request.scope equals "general_help"]`
- [conditional] Multi-deliverable scope split when prompt spans multiple incompatible recipes → `blender-recipe-decomposer` (`references/skill-blender-recipe-decomposer.md`) — `when.all: [fit.multiDeliverableDetected equals true]`
- [progression] Downstream structured brief → `intent-to-3d-brief-writer` (`references/skill-intent-to-3d-brief-writer.md`) — `when.all: [fit.verdict in ["strong_fit","partial_fit"]; brief.locked equals false]`
- [progression] Pack prerequisite verification → `pack-prerequisite-checker` (`references/skill-pack-prerequisite-checker.md`) — `when.all: [fit.verdict equals "strong_fit"; brief.locked equals true]`
- [conditional] Post-artifact stage routing → `workflow-stage-router` (`references/skill-workflow-stage-router.md`) — `when.all: [preflight.passed equals true; inventory.exists equals true]`
- [alternative] Domain scene planner (product hero) → `product-hero-scene-planner` (`references/skill-product-hero-scene-planner.md`) — `when.all: [brief.locked equals true; recipe.domain equals "product_hero"]`
- [alternative] Domain scene planner (product grid) → `product-grid-scene-planner` (`references/skill-product-grid-scene-planner.md`) — `when.all: [brief.locked equals true; recipe.domain equals "product_grid"]`
- [alternative] Domain scene planner (character portrait) → `character-portrait` (`references/skill-character-portrait.md`) — `when.all: [brief.locked equals true; recipe.domain equals "character_portrait"]`
- [alternative] Domain scene planner (environment establishing shot) → `environment-shot` (`references/skill-environment-shot.md`) — `when.all: [brief.locked equals true; recipe.domain equals "environment_shot"]`
- [alternative] Domain scene planner (interior architectural) → `interior-scene` (`references/skill-interior-scene.md`) — `when.all: [brief.locked equals true; recipe.domain equals "interior_archviz"]`

## Safety boundaries & non-goals
- Runtime boundary: Planning-only skill. Does not configure MCP, Blender, or hosts. When mentioning runtime, use the 2-path + CLI appendix model from `docs/runtime-stack-strategy.md` only as context for whether a workflow expects interactive MCP vs batch CLI — never claim runtime success.
- Brainstorming open-ended creative concepts before a goal exists (use `blender-brainstorming`).
- Authoring the locked 8-slot 3D brief (use `intent-to-3d-brief-writer`).
- Running the 7-row pack preflight gate (use `pack-prerequisite-checker`).
- Selecting MCP runtime paths, configuring Blender, or verifying rendered/exported artifacts.
